items.title: Renters Are Staying Put. These 4 Apartment REITs Could Benefit
items.summary: Fewer renters are buying homes, and apartment landlords are quietly collecting the payoff. We checked four REIT dividends against their cash flow, and the one paying the most has the thinnest safety margin. Two coastal giants didn't make the cut.

items.title: Camden Property's Q3 FFO Beats Estimates as Leasing Trends Improve
items.summary: CPT tops Q3 FFO estimates as leasing trends improve and property expenses decline, but falling revenues and same-property NOI weigh on results.

items.title: Landlord to pay $19.25M to tenants over withheld deposits — one was charged for rug cleaning but had concrete floors
items.summary: More than 200,000 former tenants could benefit from a settlement over alleged improper move-out fees.

items.title: 4 Apartment REITs Ranked by Dividend Coverage as Rental Markets Tighten
items.summary: Fewer new apartments are hitting the market just as tenants stop moving out, but not every landlord enters 2027 with the same cushion between its rental cash flow and its dividend obligation.

items.title: INVH Q3 FFO Meets Estimates, Revenues Miss, '26 Views Raised
items.summary: Invitation Homes Q3 FFO matches estimates as revenues grow 6.3%, while improving lease pricing, higher same-store NOI and raised 2026 FFO guidance support its outlook.

items.title: Mid-America's Q3 FFO Meets Estimates, Revenues Beat as Occupancy Gains
items.summary: MAA Q3 FFO matches estimates as revenues top expectations, supported by occupancy gains, stronger renewal rates and contributions from newer communities.

items.title: What Essex Property Trust (ESS) Said on Its Q3 Earnings Call
items.summary: Essex Property Trust (NYSE:ESS) raised its full-year outlook for same-property revenue growth and core funds from operations after third-quarter results benefited from stronger-than-expected performance in Northern California. items.title: Essex ups 2026 guidance amid vigorous Northern California performance
items.summary: “West Coast multifamily fundamentals offer a compelling case for continued growth above the U.S. average,” CEO Angela Kleiman said on the REIT’s third-quarter earnings call.
